stories.title: Add Atom 1.0 RSS feed endpoint at /api/feed/atom.xml for blog content syndication
stories.description: Create an Atom 1.0 XML feed endpoint that aggregates all published blog posts with proper XML structure, ISO 8601 timestamps, and feed metadata for RSS readers and search engines.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/feed/atom.xml returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/atom+xml; charset=utf-8 header
Each blog post entry includes <title>, <link>, <summary>, <published>, <updated>, <author name>, and <category term> tags with correct values from blog post metadata
Feed includes <updated> timestamp reflecting the most recent blog post publication date; feed <id> and <link> elements are present with correct self and alternate href values
technicalNotes: File to create: app/api/feed/atom.xml/route.ts (import blog posts from lib/blog/posts.ts, format Atom XML response using template string or xml builder)
Import BlogPost type from lib/blog/types.ts; validate output structure against Atom specification
Test command: npm run test -- tests/api/feed-atom.test.ts (assert Content-Type header, XML parse success, entry count matches post count, ISO 8601 dates)

stories.title: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema generator for blog post pages
stories.description: Create a reusable schema utility that generates valid BreadcrumbList JSON-LD for blog post pages with correct itemid URLs and position hierarchy (Home > Blog > Category > Post Title).
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post layout includes <script type="application/ld+json"> with @type: BreadcrumbList containing exactly 4 itemListElement objects: Home, Blog, Category, and Post Title with matching position values 1-4
Each breadcrumb itemListElement has position (number), name (string), and itemid (full absolute URL); itemid URLs must match actual Next.js route paths for category and post slug
Schema validates with zero errors in Google Rich Results Test for BreadcrumbList structure and required properties
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/schema/breadcrumb-list.ts (export function generateBreadcrumbList(postTitle: string, category: string, slug: string): BreadcrumbListSchema)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx (call generateBreadcrumbList in generateMetadata, pass result to <Script> in layout.tsx with strategy="beforeInteractive")
Test command: npm run test -- tests/lib/schema/breadcrumb-list.test.ts (assert itemListElement.length === 4, each has position 1-4, itemid is absolute URL with domain)

stories.title: Build /blog index page with category filter tabs and reading time estimates
stories.description: Create a blog listing page that displays all published posts in reverse chronological order with client-side category filtering via URL query params, tab-based navigation, and estimated reading time on each card.
acceptanceCriteria: /blog page renders grid of blog post cards; each card displays: title, 100-char excerpt, publication date (formatted), category badge, author name, and reading time estimate (e.g., '5 min read')
Category filter tabs above post list; clicking a tab filters posts and updates URL to ?category=transport; 'All Posts' tab resets filter; tab state persists across page reload
Reading time calculated as Math.ceil(wordCount / 200); each post object must have wordCount property in lib/blog/posts.ts; reading time appears on card footer below publication date
technicalNotes: File to create: app/blog/page.tsx (client component with useState for active category, useMemo to filter posts, useSearchParams to read ?category from URL)
File to modify: lib/blog/posts.ts (ensure each BlogPost object includes wordCount: number property; export function getCategoriesFromPosts(): string[])
Test command: npm run test -- tests/components/blog-index.test.tsx (assert card count on initial load, card count after filter click, reading time formula correctness, URL param update)

stories.title: Implement dynamic OG image generation for blog posts using next/og API
stories.description: Create an API route handler that generates branded Open Graph preview images for blog posts dynamically using next/og ImageResponse, featuring post title, excerpt, category badge, and hostel branding.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/og/blog?slug=post-slug-here returns PNG image with dimensions 1200x630px, Content-Type: image/png, and proper Cache-Control headers; image includes hostel logo, post title (truncated to 60 chars), excerpt (first 80 chars), category badge, and publication date

Blog post layout includes <meta property="og:image" content="https://domain.com/api/og/blog?slug=slug-here"> in <head>; also includes og:image:width="1200" and og:image:height="630" meta tags via generateMetadata export
Invalid or missing slug parameter returns 404 response; slug validation against allowlist of published blog post slugs from lib/blog/posts.ts
technicalNotes: File to create: app/api/og/blog/route.ts (import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'; GET handler accepts slug query param; fetch blog post from getBlogPosts(); render JSX to ImageResponse with Tailwind/CSS styling)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx (export generateMetadata function adding og:image, og:image:width, og:image:height meta tags; construct full URL with next/navigation baseURL utility)

Test command: npm run test -- tests/api/og-blog.test.ts (assert response image/png type, assert 404 on invalid slug, assert image dimensions); manual: curl 'http://localhost:3000/api/og/blog?slug=test-post' > test.png && file test.png

stories.title: Update sitemap.ts to automatically include all published blog posts with lastModified dates
stories.description: Modify the sitemap route handler to dynamically aggregate all published blog post URLs with correct lastModified (publication date), changeFrequency, and priority values for SEO indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /sitemap.xml returns valid XML with all blog post URLs in format: https://pelangi-capsule.com/blog/post-slug with <lastmod> set to ISO 8601 blog post publishedDate, <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>, <priority>0.7</priority>
Sitemap includes static routes (home: priority 1.0, /blog: 0.8, /guide: 0.7, /rooms: 0.8, /amenities: 0.7, /faq: 0.6) before dynamic blog post entries, all with lastmod timestamps
Blog post count in XML matches getBlogPosts().length; test assertion: xmllint --xpath 'count(//url)' sitemap.xml === (8 + blog post count)
technicalNotes: File to modify: app/sitemap.ts (import getBlogPosts from lib/blog/posts.ts; add blog post entries via Array.map((post) => ({ url: `/blog/${post.slug}`, lastModified: post.publishedDate, changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.7 })))
Helper function: lib/sitemap/format-entries.ts (export function formatBlogPostEntries(posts: BlogPost[]): MetadataRoute.Sitemap[]) to reduce app/sitemap.ts complexity
Test command: npm run build && npm run test -- tests/app/sitemap.test.ts (assert XML validity, assert blog post count in XML, assert lastmod ISO format, assert priority values)
